summary: Phase 3 UX overhaul verified end-to-end. Backend: GET /api/admin/jobs/{job_id}/fees + PATCH /api/admin/fees/{fee_id} fully tested incl. 403 for non-admin, 404 for bad id, 400 for negative amount, 422 for empty reason, monthly_fees decrement on cancel, audit log written. ReportProblemButton works for pros on JobDetailPage and Inbox conversation header (both modals open, default pricing category highlighted, submit creates support ticket — verified via Admin Support tab showing TEST_iter39 tickets). Homeowner role correctly hides both triggers. ProReviewsPanel collapsible sub-section inside AdminUsers tab confirmed (3 review rows + delete buttons after expand). AdminSupport DetailDrawer shows fee-panel-empty for tickets bound to jobs without fees.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_advanced_routes.py PATCH /fees/{fee_id} uses ObjectId(fee_id) without try/except — passing an invalid (non-hex/non-24-char) id will raise bson.errors.InvalidId and FastAPI surfaces it as a 500 instead of a clean 400/404. The current test uses a valid-format ObjectId so this code path is hidden. Recommend wrapping with try/except → HTTPException(400, 'Bad fee id').
list_job_fees does not paginate; if a job ever accumulates a large number of fee_log + payment_transactions rows the response could grow unbounded. Add a hard limit (e.g. 500).

ProReviewsPanel.fetchAll fires on every filter change; it correctly skips when collapsed=true but the initial render mounts with collapsed=true so no fetch happens — confirmed working. No infinite-loop risk.

ReportProblemButton resets subject/message on success but does not clear `category` (stays on last selection) — minor UX issue; opening the modal again starts on the last-selected category instead of the default 'pricing'. Consider resetting category to 'pricing' on close.
